components.css: :host{--ink:#18334c;--white:#fffdf8;--blue:#9fc4d5;--red:#bb503b;--rebound:#ef8068;display:block;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}.ds-chart{margin:0;padding:28px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--white) 24%,transparent);color:var(--white);background:var(--ink)}figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px}figcaption strong{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:500}figcaption span{color:#b9c6ce;font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-plot{position:relative;height:260px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 64px,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 65px)}.ds-line,.ds-rebound{position:absolute;height:4px;border-radius:4px;transform:rotate(-12deg);transform-origin:left}.ds-line{top:150px;left:8%;width:72%;background:var(--blue)}.ds-rebound{top:126px;left:48%;width:25%;background:var(--rebound);transform:rotate(14deg)}.ds-point{position:absolute;top:72px;right:12%;width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid var(--white);border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);cursor:crosshair;transition:transform .16s ease,background .16s ease}.ds-point:hover,.ds-point:focus-visible{background:var(--red);transform:scale(1.35)}aside{position:absolute;top:18px;right:0;padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--red)}aside>*{display:block}aside b,aside span{font-size:.7rem}aside strong{margin:3px 0;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.3rem}

narrative.northStar: Make a personal health report feel like a calm, evidence-led field journal: human in tone, editorial in rhythm, and honest about reversals.
narrative.overview:
Historia wagi is a bilingual, single-page editorial data journal for Hubert’s personal account of returning to health and fitness. It pairs a warm, quiet reading surface with observable evidence: milestones, small-rule lists, a raw weight line, and a deliberate summer regression.

Editorial rather than promotional, the interface gives the first-person story and its data equal weight. It remains mobile-first and legible without the JavaScript enhancements that refine the chart and header behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with navy ink and a small, disciplined red accent.
Newsreader’s editorial voice for narrative and numbers; Instrument Sans for labels and interface.
Thin rules, modular grids, and full-bleed data chapters rather than decorative cards.
Regressions remain visible and brick red; data is evidence, not a success funnel.
Authentic personal imagery is optional and never replaced with fitness-stock shorthand.

rules.name: Evidence
rules.body: Use muted blue for measurement and brick red only for change, correction, or regression; keep paper and navy as the default reading environment.

rules.name: Reportage
rules.body: Let Newsreader carry the personal narrative and large figures; Instrument Sans carries labels, navigation, and operational data.

rules.name: Flat Page
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat and use the single red offset shadow only where a competitive score needs a tactile interruption.

dos: Keep the raw line and the rebound visible.
Use thin rules and open space to structure reading.
Use red to call out a correction, warning, or competitive result.
Let large numbers appear as evidence, not calls to action.
donts: Do not turn the page into a fitness landing page or before-and-after gallery.
Do not add gradients, rounded card grids, neon green, or generic stock photography.
Do not smooth away difficult periods in the data.
Do not use the coffee link as a sticky or primary call to action.
